searchText: Hello, can you guys point me to the url to get the testvectors nightly builds? we currently use ``` url = "https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/archive/refs/tags/%s.tar.gz" % consensus_spec_version, ``` Is it of this form too? They are avaiable as a Github Actions artifact. Take a look here: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/actions/workflows/generate_vectors.yml <@755590043632140352> the latest one right now is: https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/actions/runs/10933306850 Thanks yeah I can't use that in CI in a simple way, but I can use that locally, thanks. Should be ready tomorrow atm they are not avaiable as a "fixed" url. So I guess locally is your best bet for now 🙂
